notes.title: Adjusted the drag speed again
notes.content:
The drag speed now adapts to the screen resolution and can also be customized. We hope the new maximum speed feels blazing fast!

Fixed an issue where the "Weather Control Master" achievement could not be obtained on sunny days. We apologize to the player who completed the third level three times.

Wishing everyone a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: Added custom drag speed functionality and addressed some minor issues:
notes.content:
Custom drag speed functionality allows the speed to be increased by up to 2x.

Removed the chromatic aberration effect around the edges of the screen.

Fixed an issue where dragging would continue after releasing the button.
